CLP Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, invests in, generates, transmits, and distributes electricity in Hong Kong, Mainland China, India, Southeast Asia, Taiwan, and Australia. The company has market cap of $25.99 billion. It generates electricity through coal, oil, gas, nuclear, wind, hydro, and solar power plants. It has a 15.91 P/E ratio. The firm is also involved in the provision of pumped storage and engineering services; retail of electricity and gas; property investment; and research and development activities.
